name: Akshay Pore
player_statement:
A complete player, Akshay Pore has made a big mark in cricket. With 14 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 42*, with an average of 18.89 and a quick strike rate of 129.77. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 14 sixes and 10 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 18.3 overs, taking 6 wickets at an economy rate of 5.73. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
